init.description: Destinations match as a case-insensitive substring of the text shown in the sensor's `departures` attribute, since the same destination can be worded differently depending on the station (e.g. "Flughafen/Airport ✈" vs. "Freising, Flughafen ✈") — a short filter like "Flughafen" matches both. Lines still match exactly.

data_description.destinations: Substring to match, e.g. "Flughafen" matches "Flughafen/Airport ✈" and "Freising, Flughafen ✈"
data_description.lines: Exact line names as shown live, e.g. "S1, S8"
